scope: Original Bookmark creation view/model and shared DesignKit/input/URL implementation; candidate and model remain Interfaces-owned.

recommendation.flow: Existing Create chooser → Bookmark → URL entry with inline Create. Only require a native Type choice when more than one genuinely eligible Bookmark Type exists.
recommendation.name: No mandatory NameForm before or after the URL form. Keep the explicit name empty unless the user separately chooses to name the object; use the existing Rename/Properties Name route after creation. Existing Library and document views already show localized Untitled for empty stored titles.
originalUI: One original-style URL row, with 20-point horizontal padding, 48-point row, 8-point minimum field/button spacing and original 12-point bottom spacing where it fits the existing sheet host.

Use public DesignKit.AnytypeTextField with .uxBodyRegular, Text.primary, the original URL placeholder, URL keyboard, no autocorrection, no capitalization and Done submission; inline Loc.create with existing tertiary/accent disabled/enabled colors.
Use local FocusState to reproduce the existing app-only AutofocusedTextField behavior; no new shared focus component or source change is required.
Reuse the current owned creation sheet/navigation/cancel path. A DragIndicator belongs at the sheet boundary; do not add a duplicate indicator or sheet merely for the optional name.
validation: Reuse the actual public AnytypeURL parser and original Loc.Set.Bookmark.Error.message. Keep invalid input in the same URL form.
Keep empty/loading submission guards; both Return and inline Create must use the same guarded submission path.
Do not fabricate fetched metadata, page title, preview or a URL-derived stored Name. Native metadata fetch/preview and mounted readback are separate unresolved capabilities.
dependencyAndAccessibilityNotes: AnytypeURL is in AnytypeCore. The reviewed PinkhaAnyUI Package.swift has no direct AnytypeCore product dependency; the candidate must resolve its actual module dependency/import rather than copy the parser.

AnytypeTextField currently provides a generic literal TextField accessibility label; give this URL use the existing localized placeholder label and a stable identifier without modifying the shared component.

sourceFindings: The original BookmarkCreateView has no Name field or Name screen; it displays only the URL field and Create action.
The original creation model validates with AnytypeURL before beginning its async operation and prevents empty/busy duplicate submission.
AnytypeTextField and DragIndicator have public initializers. The app-only AutofocusedTextField wraps AnytypeTextField with private FocusState and a focus task.
The native hierarchy creation plan permits an empty title and the existing Native Library/document views already render its localized Untitled fallback.

limits.remainingReview: Review the frozen Interfaces candidate for concrete SwiftUI lifecycle, module, validation and original-style behavior before source publication.
